product_one_liner.value: Hover turns smartphone photos of homes and other properties into accurate 3D models, measurements, visual designs, and estimates for construction professionals, insurance teams, and homeowners.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes photo-based 3D models and workflows for measuring, designing, estimating, and scoping property projects.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists Starter, Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans.

named_customers.notes: These names appear in Hover's customer stories.

employee_band.notes: Hover's LinkedIn company profile lists a 201–500 employee range.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies San Francisco, California as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Hover's post says, “Ever since our founding in 2011.”

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows product updates, case studies, and customer/industry content, but not at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Hover has a public Help Center with multiple articles and a developer documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current listed openings do not include a role with AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision in its title. One security engineering posting mentions securing ML workloads, but its title is not an AI/ML role.

model_provider.value: Hover's GenAI notice names Stable Diffusion, Realistic Vision, Metric3D, OneFormer, MLSD, and NormalBAE as technologies it uses; it does not identify a single exclusive model provider.
model_provider.notes: The notice says Hover combines custom generative AI technology with these publicly accessible pretrained technologies.

compliance_certs.notes: Hover's Trust Center names SOC 2 Type II. No other certification from the requested list was identified there.

last_funding.notes: The Series D announcement is dated November 17, 2020 and reports $60 million; Tracxn's 2026 company profile identifies it as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round shown in the 2026 funding profile is the November 2020 Series D, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current listed job titles include engineering, customer success, operations, design, and people roles; none is titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Hover's release collection states that new features are available in fall 2026 and lists product additions, including inspection photo sorting and custom agreement details, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The LinkedIn profile search result lists Sam Young as Hover's VP of Operations starting in March 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are named on Hover's integrations page and/or its public integration documentation.
